holdout scenario tests digital twin agent validation
LLM-as-judge cross-model code review defect detection rate
objective: Question: How do teams verify autonomous agent output without human code review: eval-driven development, scenario or holdout tests, property-based tests, LLM-as-judge, cross-model review, and digital twins of external services? What evidence exists on how well each catches defects? Rank first primary sources: engineering blog posts, docs, talks, and papers from organisations running autonomous coding agents, plus benchmark and academic studies, and credible reporting. Pull out mechanisms, numbers, names, dates, measured defect-detection or false-positive rates, and failure modes such as judge bias, reward hacking, test overfitting, and twin fidelity gaps.
